bullish: Stock is in Weinstein Stage 2 — price is above a rising 30-week MA
Mansfield RS is positive and trending upward vs Nifty 50 and Nifty 500
VCP or Stage 2 breakout pattern is visible on the daily chart
Breakout volume is above the 50-SMA of volume (volume confirmation)
EMA 20 (Daily) is sloping up and acting as support
bearish: Stock is in Weinstein Stage 3 or Stage 4 — price is below a declining 30-week MA
Mansfield RS is negative or rolling over vs Nifty 50 and Nifty 500
Price is breaking down through key supply/demand zones or the 30-week MA
Volume is expanding to the downside
neutral: Stock is in Weinstein Stage 1 — basing, 30-week MA is flat
Mansfield RS is hovering near zero — no clear outperformance or underperformance
Price is consolidating in a range with no directional conviction — wait for breakout

risk_rules: Risk per trade: 1% of total capital — no exceptions, no discretionary overrides
Position sizing is volatility-adjusted using 14-day ATR: Position Size = Risk Amount / (ATR × Multiplier)
Stop-loss: mandatory ATR-based trailing stop set on every position at entry
Only trade Stage 2 breakouts — never enter a Stage 3 or Stage 4 stock
Swing trades target 5–8% over 8–12 weeks; exit immediately if the Stage 2 thesis breaks
Positional trades target 10–30% over 6–8 months; hold as long as Stage 2 is intact and RS is positive
NSE trading hours only: 9:15 AM – 3:30 PM IST
Weekend focus: Hunter Picks and EarlyBird Picks — fresh Stage 2 breakouts and setups
Weekday focus: Pullback Picks — entries on retracements within confirmed Stage 2 trends
Capital rotation: use the Sell-to-Buy matrix to recycle capital from exits into new setups systematically
notes: NSE-listed Indian equities only. Default exchange: NSE. Default currency: INR (₹1,23,456 format). Primary framework is Weinstein Stage Analysis anchored to the 30-week MA. All Relative Strength is Mansfield RS benchmarked vs Nifty 50, Nifty 500, and the relevant sector index — 52-week RS is primary, 3-month and 6-month RS are tactical/timing. Alpha Score (5-star composite of Stage + RS + Volatility) drives stock selection priority. Indicators — EMA 20, SMA 50, ATR 14, RSI — are used for confluence only. Pure price action leads all decisions.
